summary: Ascentage Pharma Group International filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 13, 2026, furnishing press releases announcing its participation in the Evercore 2nd Annual China Biotech Summit and correcting the timing of its 2026 interim results webcast. The filing is a routine report of a foreign private issuer regarding scheduled investor events and earnings disclosure dates. No corporate transaction, stake change, tender offer, or strategic action was announced. The contents are ordinary operational communications with no special-situation characteristics, such as acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes. The filing simply updates shareholders on upcoming investor relations activities and contains no deal terms or financial structures warranting classification as a special situation.
